note: The chapter register. A chapter is listed only after it reaches conformance level two on its own domain and the steward has approved its charter; the survey (scripts/chapters-survey.mjs) reads this list, never the other way round. Empty is the honest state until the first founding chapter is approved.

requires: A named lead who can be asked why, with a public person/ id of their own assertion
A city, and a monthly build night with a venue a stranger can find
The chapter kit run on the chapter's own domain, reaching L2
The code of conduct adopted in the chapter's own charter
